Betterton found Higgins too good for him in the 440 Yards, but gave the winner a good race. Eric Bishop gained third place in the 880, and then in the 1 Mile we called upon Derrick Burfitt to assist us, and he simply walked away from his field, and Derrick certainly makes running look a very easy business.

Betterton and Freestone were first and second in the 440 and Eric Bishop gained third place in the 880 Yards. Arthur Bruce won the 1 Mile, and although the S.L.H. boys won the Relay, we picked up some useful points in the Field Events through the help of Alan Dunn, Dennis Fleming and A.
